name: Reflection
source:
It's a good time to reflect on the past and rest.

Reflection is a short visual novel about some of my experiences in winter.

[From [url=https://patchoulibard.itch.io/reflection]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在是反思过去和休息的好时机。

《反思》是一部简短的视觉小说，讲述了我在冬天的一些经历。

[来自[url=https://patchoulibard.itch.io/reflection]Itch.io[/url]]
